item.title: LLVM AI tool policy: human in the loop
item.description:
📝 LLVM AI Tool Use Policy Policy LLVM’s policy is that contributors can use whatever tools they would like to craft their contributions, but there must be a human in the loop. Similarly, automated review tools that publish comments without human review are not allowed. However, an opt-in review tool that keeps a human in the loop is acceptable under this policy.
🔗 Read more: https://discourse.llvm.org/t/rfc-llvm-ai-tool-policy-human-in-the-loop/89159
